sources.title: British Council — Present continuous
sources.conclusion: Be agreement and -ing; moment/temporary process; negatives place not after be; pronoun+be or be+not contractions; future arrangements are another use, not a mechanical tomorrow/now rule.

sources.title: British Council — Stative verbs
sources.conclusion: State versus action depends on meaning: have/think can take dynamic meanings. Temporary state is not by itself permission to use Continuous.
